profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Open
profile.summary: Senior backend engineer building production LLM systems — agent orchestration, function calling, structured output, and multi-layer validation. I design and build distributed backend system and ship full-stack independent products solo, including mobile apps in Flutter. MS CS in progress at Georgia Tech, Computational Perception and Robotics.

positions.description: - Designed event-triggered workflow automation with Airtable and custom scripts; replaced manual spreadsheet tracking and ad-hoc status emails with automated notifications, reducing operator workload by 50%+ across all staff

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Engineered fraud prevention system, leveraging image analysis service for photo verification, leading to a 50% reduction in ban reports and a significant improvement in user safety.
- Enhanced system stability and reduced user data sync time by 30% for 200K+ monthly active users by leveraging Google Cloud Functions with batch processing and pub/sub architecture.
- Implemented a full-stack gamification system using Flutter, Typescript, and Firestore, integrating real-time backend updates with frontend state via reactive listeners to enhance UX and increase user retention by 20%.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Contributed as a fullstack engineer at a music licensing tech startup to develop and maintain backend RESTful APIs, using Node.js, Javascript and GCP, resulting in a 15% increase in system performance and application stability.
• Developed a custom admin dashboard using Vue.js and GCP to streamline user management process, decreasing user control processing time by 75%.
• Designed and implemented a search query logging feature, using Node.js, Cloud Functions, and Vue.js, improving query response time by 20% and accuracy by 10%.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Collaborated with scientists and researchers to identify key features and parameters in dataset, resulting in a more accurate and comprehensive understanding of the bed topography of Antarctica and Greenland
• Engineered and optimized Python-based data processing pipelines to handle large bed topography datasets, reducing processing time by 30% and allowing for faster analysis
• Conducted statistical analysis and data visualization using pandas, numpy, and scipy, providing valuable insights for the research team and contributing to the publication.

projects.title: Customer Rating Prediction System
projects.description:
Project with global transaction company, Exactuals

• Integrated prediction model to the application, utilizing XGBoost to predict customer satisfaction rating based on their previous transaction
• Responsible for establishing entire backend infrastructure, from database modeling to prediction API integration
